info.title: vcon.store API
info.description: Hosted vCon Conserver API by Everycast Labs. Manage vCons (virtual conversation containers) per the IETF vCon specification (draft-ietf-vcon-vcon-core-02). Authenticate with a Bearer API key.
info.x-sipnab-provenance: VENDORED, NOT AUTHORED HERE. Fetched from https://api.vcon.store/openapi.json on 2026-08-27. This is a SECOND consumer's schema, kept beside the working group's own so `a_container_meets_or_knowingly_diverges_from_the_second_consumer` can state exactly how a sipnab container fares against a real store rather than against the format alone. Do not edit it to make a test pass -- the whole value is that it is somebody else's. Re-fetch to update, and expect the divergence test to need rewriting when you do.

_role.description: Role: org_signing_key (per-org, signs statements) or platform_service_key (shared, signs receipts)

200.description: Platform service public key in JWKS format

200.description: A paginated list of vCon objects

post.description: Validates the vCon against the IETF vCon specification (draft-ietf-vcon-vcon-core-02) and stores it. The `uuid` must be unique within your organisation. Fields `redacted`, `amended`, and `group` are mutually exclusive.

analysis.body: Hello, thanks for calling Acme Corp. How can I help you today?

201.description: The created vCon, echoed back with any server-set fields

400.description: Validation failed — the body is not a valid vCon

get.description: Retrieves a single vCon by its UUID, including all parties, dialogs, analysis, and attachments.

404.description: No vCon found with this UUID

put.description: Fully replaces a vCon with the provided body. The UUID in the route must match the body (or be omitted in the body). Creates a SCITT ledger entry recording the replacement. Use PATCH for partial updates.

404.description: No vCon found with this UUID

patch.description: Partially updates a vCon in-place. Arrays (analysis, attachments, parties) are **appended** to the existing arrays. Scalar fields (subject) are overwritten. This modifies the vCon directly — for spec-compliant derivative creation, use POST /{uuid}/amend instead.

404.description: No vCon found with this UUID

delete.description: Permanently removes a vCon and its associated SCITT ledger entries. This action cannot be undone.

404.description: No vCon found with this UUID

get.description: Returns the append-only SCITT (Supply Chain Integrity, Transparency and Trust) ledger entries for this vCon. Each entry records a lifecycle operation (create, update, transfer, redact) with a content hash for tamper evidence.

200.description: Ordered list of SCITT ledger entries

get.description: Returns the lineage graph for this vCon, showing parent/child relationships from amendments, redactions, and group membership.

200.description: Lineage graph: every vCon reachable from this one via parent or child derivation, plus the directed edges between them.

post.description: Triggers an AI analysis workflow for this vCon. The analysis result is stored as a new amended derivative — the original vCon is never modified. Requires AI analysis to be enabled and configured for the organisation.

instanceId.description: Workflow instance ID for status polling

post.description: Triggers a transcription workflow for audio dialogs in this vCon. Transcripts are stored as analysis entries on a new amended derivative. If AI analysis is also configured, it runs automatically after transcription completes. Requires transcription to be enabled and configured for the organisation.

instanceId.description: Workflow instance ID for status polling

post.description: Creates a new vCon with specified PII removed. The original is preserved unchanged. Per the IETF vCon spec (draft-ietf-vcon-vcon-core-02), redacted party slots are replaced with empty objects to preserve array indices. The new vCon's `redacted.uuid` references the original. Both vCons receive SCITT ledger entries.
Creates a new vCon with additional analysis or attachments appended to the original's content. The original is preserved unchanged. The new vCon's `amended.uuid` references the original.

Creates a new group vCon that bundles multiple existing vCons together (e.g. a multi-session customer journey). All member UUIDs must exist. The group vCon's `group[]` array references the members. Each member receives a SCITT ledger entry recording the grouping.

400.description: One or more member vCons not found

get.description: Returns all versions of a vCon — the original plus any redacted, amended, or grouped derivatives, ordered chronologically.
Returns details about the authenticated organisation including plan, status, and usage counters.

aiApiKey.description: Plaintext API key — stored encrypted, never returned.

transcriptionApiKey.description: Plaintext transcription API key — stored encrypted, never returned.

get.description: Returns usage metrics for the current billing period (calendar month).
Returns all API keys for the organisation. The full key value is never returned — only the prefix for identification.

200.description: List of API keys (key values are redacted)

post.description: Creates a new API key for the organisation. The full key is returned **only once** in this response — store it securely. Subsequent requests will only show the prefix.

name.description: A human-readable label for this key

201.description: API key created — the full key is only shown here

delete.description: Permanently revokes an API key. Revoked keys cannot be used for authentication and cannot be un-revoked.

schema.description: The API key ID to revoke

parameters.description: The API key ID to revoke
parameters.name: id

post.description: Returns a storage key and upload URL for a new media file. After receiving the response, PUT the raw file bytes to the `uploadUrl` with the appropriate `Content-Type` header. The returned `key` can then be used as the `url` field in vCon dialog objects.

200.description: Upload details including the storage key and PUT URL

delete.description: Permanently removes a media file from storage. This does not automatically update any vCon dialog objects that reference this file — you should update or delete those separately.

schema.description: The storage key returned from the upload endpoint

parameters.description: The storage key returned from the upload endpoint
parameters.name: key

403.description: The media key does not belong to your organisation

post.description: Submits a vCon for async processing: validation, storage, consent parsing, retention scheduling, and automatic transcription/analysis if enabled in organisation settings.
Starts a workflow to find and redact/delete all vCons containing a specific party. Use for GDPR erasure requests.

get.description: Polls the status of a running or completed workflow instance.

get.summary: Get signing keys for this org (JWKS)
get.description: Returns the JWKS containing both the org's ECDSA P-256 signing key (used for signed statements) and the vcon.store platform's service key (used for receipts). Verify signed statements with the org key and receipts with the platform key.

get.summary: Get SCITT transparency ledger for a vCon
get.description: Returns all SCITT ledger entries for a vCon, including signed statements (org key) and receipts (platform key). Each entry represents a lifecycle event (created, redacted, amended, grouped, deleted).

post.summary: Verify COSE Sign1 signed statement and/or receipt
post.description: Verifies a signed statement against the org's key and/or a receipt against the platform service key. Provide one or both. The signed_statement proves the org submitted the vCon; the receipt proves vcon.store logged it.

get.description: Returns all members of the authenticated organisation with their roles.

delete.description: Removes a member from the organisation. Cannot remove the last owner.

404.description: Member not found in this org

patch.description: Changes a team member's role (owner, admin, member).

get.description: Returns all pending invitations for the organisation.

post.description: Sends an invitation email to the specified address. The invitee can accept to join the organisation.

400.description: User already a member or invitation already pending

post.description: Accepts a pending invitation and adds the authenticated user to the organisation. The user must be logged in.

200.description: Invitation accepted, user added to org

400.description: Invitation expired, already accepted, or user already a member

403.description: Organisation has reached its member limit

delete.description: Revokes a pending invitation so it can no longer be accepted.
